extracted.name: Buttermilk Ranch Cheese Ball
extracted.description: This simple Hidden Valley Ranch cheese ball is coated with pecans and is quick to make. It's a great way to make an appetizer at a moment's notice.
ingredient_lines: 1 (1 ounce) package ranch dressing mix (such as Hidden Valley Ranch ®)
instruction_lines: Mix sour cream with ranch dressing mix in a bowl until smoothly combined. Add cream cheese and Cheddar cheese to the bowl and mix together with your hands until thoroughly blended. Chill mixture for 5 minutes, then shape into a ball.
Place pecans into a shallow bowl and roll all sides of cheese ball in pecans to coat. Serve immediately.
